items.title: Knowledge Management for Coding Agents | AI Poland 2026
items.summary: An agent makes an architectural decision, the session ends, and the repository holds the result without any underlying reasoning. Three months later, someone looks for the rationale and finds the commit. This talk highlights the problems this creates in ongoing projects, ranging from onboarding and code reviews to the question of why an agent proposes the exact same rejected solution for the third time. After that, we explore the countermeasures: documented decisions, logged tool calls, and a wiki that agents can read and write themselves. Projects we implement internally at SHI and with our clients serve as examples, complete with the artifacts that nobody bothered to maintain after three weeks.
